items.title: Widerspruch against Grundsicherung decision
items.quote: Die Frist dafür beträgt einen Monat ab Bekanntgabe; der Widerspruch ist schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei Kreisverwaltung Beispiel-Westerwald, Peter-Altmeier-Platz 2, 56410 Musterbaur einzulegen.
items.computation: Letter dated Friday 20.11.2026, sent by simple post (einfacher Brief) by a social-law body (Sozialamt/Kreisverwaltung, § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X). Delivery fiction: the 4th day after posting counts as delivery. Day 1 = 21.11, Day 2 = 22.11, Day 3 = 23.11, Day 4 = 24.11.2026 (Tuesday). For social-law bodies the delivery day does not move even if it fell on a weekend/holiday, but 24.11.2026 is a regular Tuesday anyway, so delivery = 24.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist (§ 84 SGG / § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) is computed under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB: it ends on the day one month later that bears the same number as the delivery day, i.e. 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in Rheinland-Pfalz (24 Dec counts as a working day), so no shift under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X is needed.
